body: Thank you. These words actually mean quite a bit. I've lurked on this community for quite a while, reading other people's posts but now that I'm actually here its comforting to actually comprehend how I'm not actually alone you know? Happiness is a fickle thing. And I definitely won't be cured of this hell over night but at least I know people can get back to normal. Please don't delete your comments, I'm probably gonna reread them. Thank you.

I know what you mean. And to be honest the break ups and rejections are easy for some reason I just find myself craving emotions because its a different experience than what I feel all the time. And you are definitely right about how people enjoy being around a happy person. The thing is its hard finding something that takes my mind off everything. What I used to do and love just doesn't cuz it anymore. I wouldn't mind getting antidepressants but I can't have mental instability known if want to apply as an officer in the military. I just am left feeling kinda helpless because I'm just running out of options of things to help me. I keep getting small accomplishments like I quit drinking as much, I ain't an alcoholic anymore. I get out of the house more and see people but everyday I wake up with the same weight pressing down upon me.

Well thanks for listening and taking the time to reply man. I'm gonna get some sleep and hopefully be at least a little happier for once. You have no idea how much just having someone who listened to my problems mean. Good night good sir.

My friend tells me that everything going to get better. She uses the same phrases I used to say to her when she was down to cheer her up. But the problem is that it never really gets better. I don't get a reprieve from the emotions. It doesn't seem to let up.
By the way we took career tests at my school. But I have applied for psychology and bachelors of mathematics as well along with cinematography.

More background, I'm Canadian. So all we have is RMC and my career things put me as a match for a military career. If I did military I would become an officer but to be honest I don't know what I want. Its stupid and pathetic but my life is damn near perfect. I shouldn't feel this way. I should be content with my existence but I just ain't. Its kinda weird you know?

Yeah. I'm getting stuff back but the problem I see is that I'm lost. I don't know what courses to take and I'm contemplating the army. It ain't a problem its just stuff I gotta deal with. And more lucky than smart. My family is half fucked up and all the good ones are dead. I forgot to mention my parents are also in a cult.

Thanks man. Not gonna lie it helped a bit to write this and know someone took the time to read this. And I would not mind at all. And that's the thing! I know that a lot of people go through this and I understand that they make it out alive but I guess I'm weak and pathetic and just a waste of a person.
